## Checklist

- [ ] `bash tools/agents/check.sh` passed (and `pnpm lint` for `web/`)
- [ ] If the API changed: `api/openapi.yaml` is updated and `pnpm gen:api` regenerated `web/src/shared/api/schema.gen.ts`
- [ ] If user-facing texts or docs changed: both English and Russian are updated
- [ ] Commits follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/whoaskedssselery/Zazzzor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#commits)
